LeHeup Hill is a 243-foot summit in Florida. The LeHeup Hill Trail covers 0.5 miles with about 33 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 28.29388, -82.16727 (tap for driving directions). Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

This trail is hikeable most of the year. Summer brings heat and humidity — carry extra water — while fall and spring offer the most comfortable conditions. Ice is possible on shaded stretches in mid-winter.

Know Before You Go

Most hikers should budget about 0.5 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent.
